      ShrinkEarn, srnky and ShrinkMe link resolver

      Use this ShrinkEarn bypass to reveal the destination behind a supported ShrinkEarn, srnky, ShrinkMe, Cuty or OUO shortener link. Paste the URL above to open its destination automatically, or turn off automatic opening to review and copy the direct link.

      How to resolve a short link

      1. Paste your shortened URL in the Short link field.
      2. Complete the verification, then select Resolve link.
      3. Your destination opens automatically. Turn off automatic opening to review or copy it first.

      Supported links include srnky, ShrinkEarn, ShrinkMe (shrinkme.click, shrinkme.io and shrinkme.site), Cuty (cuty.io and cuttty.com), OUO (ouo.io and ouo.press), AdvertisingCamps, and Loanbixby shortened URLs.

      Each shortener follows its own verification and redirect sequence. If verification does not complete, use Open original link to continue on the shortener.

      Does this create new short links?

      This tool resolves existing short links to their destinations. To shorten a new URL, use the shortener that creates those links.

      Why does resolving a link take time?

      Some shorteners require verification and a server wait before revealing a destination. A yellow countdown shows the remaining wait when available. Busy periods can add queue time; previously resolved links can return faster from the cache.
